legal_citations.title: Article 8: Price of the Commodity and Service; Invoice
legal_citations.text: The provider shall clearly write the price; advertising of prices must not be misleading; and the provider shall provide the consumer with a detailed invoice containing its trade name, address, commodity or service type, price and quantity and any other data prescribed by the Executive Regulation.

legal_citations.title: Article 4: Consumer Rights
legal_citations.text: All prescribed obligations are consumer rights, including: obtaining true information on the commodities or service; protecting consumers' privacy and data security and not using these for promotion; fair and quick settlement for consumers' disputes; and obtaining fair compensation for damages caused to them or their property as a result of purchasing or using the commodity or receiving the service.

legal_citations.title: Article 19: Monopoly and Overcharging
legal_citations.text: The provider is prohibited from concealing the commodity, refraining from selling it, adding terms for using the service, selling a commodity with another, or charging a price higher than the declared price.

legal_citations.title: Article 1: Definition: Invoice
legal_citations.text: Invoice: Any instrument sufficient by itself to prove the transaction or contracting with the consumer on a commodity or service, provided it contains the data required by this Law or its Executive Regulation.

legal_citations.title: Article 12: Flaw in the Commodity or Service
legal_citations.text: In case of discovering a flaw in the commodity or service, the provider shall repair, replace or recover the commodity and reimburse its price, or re-provide the service without charge, as prescribed by the Executive Regulation.
